mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports anticancer activity at the 25% methanol peptide-fraction level against MCF-7 cells, with selectivity assessed against Vero cells; it does not directly assay each identified peptide as a separate anticancer agent.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: 25% methanol peptide fraction from Naja kaouthia venom protein hydrolysate
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is activity evidence, not a molecular mechanism; individual peptide IC50 values are not reported.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Docking analysis supports EGFR as a computational target hypothesis for the identified peptides, with WWSDHR and IWDTIEK having the strongest reported binding affinities among the peptide set.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Table 4 peptides, especially WWSDHR and IWDTIEK

locators: xml:sec=19:Docking study of the peptide to EGFR protein

mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking is in silico support only; it is not a direct EGFR inhibition assay or cellular mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper discusses membrane interaction, pore-forming, cell-penetrating, and tumor-targeting peptide mechanisms as background ACP biology, but does not experimentally demonstrate those mechanisms for the Naja kaouthia peptides in this study.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Kept as context only; not promoted to a direct mechanism claim.
